params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of results to be returned. The maximum results returned by the server is 1000 even if you specify a higher limit.

params.name: cursor
params.description:
Cursor for paging through results. In general, if a response contains a `nextCursor`
property, it means that there may be more results, and you should pass that value as the
`cursor` parameter in the next request.

Note that the cursor may or may not be encrypted, but either way, it is not intended to be
decoded. Its internal structure is not a part of the public API, and may change without
notice. You should treat it as an opaque string and not attempt to craft your own cursors.

params.name: assetExternalIds
params.description: Asset external IDs of related equipment that this file relates to. Takes 1..100 unique items.

params.name: rootAssetIds
params.description: Only include files that have a related asset in a tree rooted at any of these root assetIds.

params.name: assetSubtreeIds
params.description: Only include files that have a related asset in a subtree rooted at any of these assetIds (including the roots given). If the total size of the given subtrees exceeds 100,000 assets, an error will be returned.

params.name: assetSubtreeExternalIds
params.description: Only include files that have a related asset in a subtree rooted at any of these assetExternalIds (including the roots given). If the total size of the given subtrees exceeds 100,000 assets, an error will be returned.

params.name: minSourceCreatedTime
params.description: Include files that have sourceCreatedTime set and with minimum this value.

params.name: maxSourceCreatedTime
params.description: Include files that have sourceCreatedTime set and with maximum this value.

params.name: minSourceModifiedTime
params.description: Include files that have sourceModifiedTime set and with minimum this value.

params.name: maxSourceModifiedTime
params.description: Include files that have sourceModifiedTime set and with maximum this value.

params.name: uploaded
params.description: Whether or not the actual file is uploaded. This field is returned only by the API, it has no effect in a post body.

params.name: partition
params.description:
Splits the data set into `N` partitions.
The attribute is specified as a "M/N" string, where `M` is a natural number in the interval of `[1, N]`.
You need to follow the cursors within each partition in order to receive all the data.

The maximum number of allowed partitions (`N`) is 10.

Cognite rejects requests if you specify more than 10 partitions.
When Cognite enforces this behavior, the requests result in a 400 Bad Request status.

params.name: overwrite
params.description:
If 'overwrite' is set to true, and the POST body content specifies a 'externalId' field, fields for the file found for externalId can be overwritten. The default setting is false.

If metadata is included in the request body, all of the original metadata will be overwritten.
The actual file will be overwritten after a successful upload with the uploadUrl from the response.
If there is no successful upload, the current file contents will be kept.

File-Asset mappings only change if explicitly stated in the assetIds field of the POST json body.
Do not set assetIds in request body if you want to keep the current file-asset mappings.
